# Goal
Tabi round15 only. Lane /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin. L1 holds canonical planner seat. Declared C1 operability8 (lowest tie): truthful USER counter refusal diagnostics with explicit applicability/reason and isolated CLI expected-reason assertions, 0→1 verified diagnostic contract. C2 calibration9: historical ARIA metadata gate checks all emitted cleanup/qualification mirrors and classifies authenticated snapshot tampering as could-not-evaluate; 0→1 verified enforced contract. Independent claims, no new browser run/coverage/scalar inflation.
# Contract
Leaves only; no delegation, commits, background jobs. Skip ALL build/test/lint/format/selftest/smoke execution; L1 runs checks after integration. Read-only unless explicit ownership; assigned Report is your only default write. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/<that path>. All source paths below relative to this absolute lane root unless explicitly external. Reports are author-side, never non-author certification. Message only TabiR15 or a known sibling by exact id; never Main/orchestrator or agent://all. No fleet/sibling/MANIFEST edits. Never open/copy/query/modify ~/.omp/agent/agent.db* or any credential/auth file, never launch separate omp CLI. Tooling authorization: install/upgrade helpful tools after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md; official channels/update-safety gate; report tool/version/channel/reason. Pacman guard: before pacman -S run pacman -Sp --print-format '%n %v' <pkgs>; proceed only if every listed package is not installed (pacman -Q fails); no -Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, downgrade, host service restart. Historical evidence/lessons immutable; L1 owns LOG/SCORECARD/QUALITY/SKILL/README/round15 lesson and source row integration. Report concrete pointers, findings and commands L1 should run, never fabricate outcomes.
